glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 金 (“metal; gold; money”) + phonetic 戔.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 錢 (釒 → 钅 and 戔 → 戋); compare 残.
senses: [jiǎn] (obsolete in standard Chinese) a kind of farm tool
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 錢; s_page_origin explains the simplified 钱.
